name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
description: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment per year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
impact: Transformed rural livelihoods, reduced distress migration, empowered women (55% of beneficiaries), built durable community assets.
key_achievements: 7.3 billion person-days of employment per year

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
description: National mission for financial inclusion to ensure access to financial services — savings accounts, credit, insurance, and pension for the unbanked.
impact: Brought over 52 crore unbanked Indians into the formal banking system, enabled direct benefit transfers, reduced leakages.
key_achievements: Rs 2.33 lakh crore balance in accounts

name: Right to Information Act
ministry: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions
description: Empowers citizens to request information from any public authority, promotes transparency and accountability in government functioning.
impact: Exposed corruption, improved governance, empowered citizens. Over 60 lakh RTI applications filed annually.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Aims to provide affordable housing to the urban poor and rural households by 2024 under the Housing for All mission.
impact: Over 4 crore houses sanctioned and 3 crore completed, addressing urban slum rehabilitation and rural housing deficit.
source: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

name: Ayushman Bharat — Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: World's largest government-funded health insurance scheme providing Rs 5 lakh cover per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation.
impact: Over 5.5 crore hospital admissions covered, saving millions from catastrophic health expenditure.
key_achievements: Rs 5 lakh per family per year cover

name: Mid-Day Meal Scheme (PM POSHAN)
description: Provides free nutritious meals to children in government schools to improve enrollment, attendance, retention, and nutritional levels.
impact: Dramatically improved school attendance especially for girls, reduced dropout rates, addressed child malnutrition.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
description: Provides free LPG connections to women from BPL households to replace polluting cooking fuels and improve women's health.
impact: Freed 9.5 crore women from indoor air pollution, reduced respiratory diseases, improved women's dignity.
key_achievements: Saved 5 lakh+ lives from smoke inhalation
source: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

name: Swachh Bharat Mission
description: Aims to eliminate open defecation and construct toilets across rural and urban India to achieve clean India by Gandhi's 150th birth anniversary.
impact: Built over 11 crore toilets, achieved Open Defecation Free (ODF) status in 6 lakh villages, dramatically improved public health.

name: National Food Security Act / Public Distribution System
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
description: Legally entitles up to 75% of rural and 50% of urban population to subsidised food grains at Rs 1–3 per kg under the PDS.
impact: Prevented widespread starvation and malnutrition. During COVID, provided free rations to 80 crore people under PM Garib Kalyan Yojana.
key_achievements: COVID free ration to 80 crore people

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Provides Rs 6,000 annual income support directly to small and marginal farmers' bank accounts in three equal instalments.
impact: Directly transferred over Rs 2.8 lakh crore to 11 crore farmers, reducing dependence on moneylenders.
source: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: Jal Jeevan Mission
description: Aims to provide functional household tap water connections to all rural households to deliver safe and adequate drinking water by 2024.
impact: Connected 14 crore+ rural homes with tap water, replacing dependence on contaminated sources.
key_achievements: Water quality testing in all villages

name: Right to Education Act
description: Makes free and compulsory education a fundamental right for all children aged 6–14 years and sets minimum standards for schools.
impact: Achieved near universal elementary enrolment (96.9%), abolished corporal punishment, mandated private school 25% EWS reservation.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
description: Provides collateral-free loans up to Rs 10 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises to promote entrepreneurship.
impact: Over 46 crore loans totalling Rs 26 lakh crore disbursed, empowering micro-entrepreneurs especially women and SC/ST communities.

name: Goods and Services Tax
description: Unified India's complex multi-layered indirect tax structure into a single, streamlined tax system to create one national market.
impact: Eliminated cascading taxes, created one national market, formalised 14 lakh new businesses, monthly collections cross Rs 1.7 lakh crore.
key_achievements: Unified India into a single market

name: Aadhaar — Unique Identification
description: World's largest biometric digital identity system providing a unique 12-digit identification number to every resident of India.
impact: 138 crore Aadhaar issued, saved Rs 2.23 lakh crore in government subsidy leakages by eliminating ghost beneficiaries.

name: National Pension System
description: Voluntary, defined-contribution pension scheme open to all Indian citizens between 18–70 years, providing retirement corpus.
impact: Assets under management cross Rs 11 lakh crore, covering 6.5 crore subscribers including government employees and voluntary members.
key_achievements: Atal Pension Yojana — 5.25 crore unorganised sector workers

name: Digital India Programme
description: Transform India into a digitally empowered society and knowledge economy by expanding broadband, digital literacy, and e-governance services.
impact: 1.6 billion+ UPI transactions per month, 5.5 lakh CSCs, rural broadband via BharatNet, digital payments revolution.

name: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana
description: Provides all-weather road connectivity to unconnected habitations with population of 500+ (250+ in hilly/tribal areas).
impact: Constructed 7.5 lakh km of rural roads connecting 1.72 lakh habitations, transforming rural market access and healthcare reach.

name: Integrated Child Development Services
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: World's largest early childhood development programme providing nutrition, pre-school education and health services to children under 6 and pregnant/nursing mothers.
impact: Reduced infant mortality, improved child nutrition, 15.8 crore beneficiaries through 13.8 lakh Anganwadi centres.
source: Ministry of Women and Child Development

name: Rashtriya Swasthya Bima Yojana / ESIC
description: Health insurance for BPL workers and ESIC for organised sector employees providing cashless medical coverage.
impact: 14 crore covered under ESIC, protecting organised sector workers and their families from medical expenses.
